title: CPC-2023-2306-GPA-VZC-HD-MCUP-PR
text:
CPC-2023-2306-GPA-VZC-HD-MCUP-PR  Council District: 1 – Hernandez
  CEQA: ENV-2023-2307-EIR  Last Day to Act: 11-09-26
  Plan Area: Central City North

  PUBLIC HEARING – Completed August 26, 2026

  PROJECT SITE:  110 – 130 West College Street; 117 – 119 West Bruno Street;
  943 – 973 North Main Street

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Removal of an existing surface parking lot to construct a new five-story, 232,802-square-foot commercial
  development consisting of 224,597 square feet of office, 4,095 square feet of restaurant, and 4,110 square
  feet of retail uses, on an approximately 2.2-acre site. The Project would have a maximum building height of
  88 feet and includes parking within one subterranean level and two above-grade levels.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Sections 15162 and 15164, in
  consideration of the whole of the administrative record, that the Project was assessed in the previously
  certified Environmental Impact Report No. ENV-2023-2307-EIR, certified on August 28, 2026, and no
  subsequent EIR, negative declaration, or addendum is required for approval of the Project;
  2. Pursuant to Charter Section 555 and Chapter 1 Section 11.5.6 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC),
  a General Plan Amendment to amend the Central City North Community Plan to remove Footnote No. 7
  from the Project Site, which would otherwise limit the Floor Area Ratio (FAR) for commercial development
  at the Project Site to a maximum of 1.5:1 FAR;
  3. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1A Sections 13B.1.4.I., a Vesting Zone and Height District Change Ordinance
  from [Q]C2-2-RIO and [T][Q]C2-2-RIO to (T)(Q)C2-2D-RIO;
  4. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.24 W.1, a Main Conditional Use Permit for the sale and
  dispensing of a full-line of alcohol beverages for on-site and off-site consumption within up to three
  establishments, in connection with the proposed restaurant and retail spaces; and
  5. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 16.05, a Project Review for a development which creates, or results
  in an increase of 50,000 gross square feet or more of non-residential area.

  Applicant:  S&R Partners, LLC
  Representative: Edgar Khalatian, Mayer Brown, LLP

  Staff:  Lakshmi Gangamreddypalli, Planning Assistant
  lakshmi.gangamreddypalli@lacity.org
  (213) 978-1394
summary: Zone change, plan amendment and alcohol permit for a five-story, 232,802-square-foot office, restaurant and retail building replacing a surface parking lot near College and Main streets.
